description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is hiring a DevID Software Engineer to provide test validation and user support for the DevID service used in its Factory Build process. The role focuses on test automation, defect and release processes, and collaboration with development and infrastructure teams.
Software quality engineer for factory build and device identity products, developing test cases and validating requirements

Responsibilities:
• Able to follow HPE processes for defect life cycle and build/release requirements with minimum guidance
• Able to follow current team process standards; document, communicate, and implement in a timely fashion any required test case addition/revision to validate enhancements that are discovered during development, test, and integration – these changes are to be applied while enabling common source sharing
• Able to participate in definition and finalization of Product Strategy and SPEC requirements for new DevID product functional needs
• Able to provide POC and Demonstrations for test cases; as needed; to help validate requirements with usage of HPE agreed upon tools
• Provide weekly status report on time; including progress against agreed to schedule tasks
• Maintain a quality focused with constant attention to detail. Not afraid to ask questions and/or provide feedback on strategy and/or issue resolution
• Must be assertive and self-driven that ensures timely and successful completion of all assigned tasks with minimal guidance
• Provide excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts at all levels of HPE management

Requirements:
• Candidate must be a US Citizen or currently have a Green Card
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent work experience
• Minimum of 1 year of applicable and documented technical experience in following areas:
• Experience or understanding of software quality assurance tools and processes. Understanding of basic testing, coding, and debugging procedures
• Experience with application/service/tool setup, configuration and practices
• Experience with HPE hardware setup/configuration (server, storage and switch)
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills
• Basic understanding of design for software and firmware running on multiple platform types (Linux and Windows)
• Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English

Preferred:
• Familiarity with HPE hardware (server, storage and switch)
• Familiarity with application observability setup and practices
• Familiarity with AI in generation of product code validation test
• Familiarity with GitHub Repositories in relation to supporting a multi-environment deployment model
• Familiarity with DevID standards (IEEE 802.1AR)
• Familiarity of applied cryptography experience especially with X.509 certificate chains, RSA and/or ECC
